extracted_decision.summary: Hand the whole UI/UX to the system: implement missing UI, ask the UI/UX Designer, fix bugs, improve it, make it a task, and handle it automatically.
extracted_decision.rationale: Direct manager order grants a full UI/UX completeness pass on autopilot with closure on green.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: No manager pauses; quality rests on the Designer-led plan, spotless, TDD for the endpoint, bridge QA, and bridge review.

verbatim_quote.original: راستی کل ui/ux رو بده به سیستم بگو هرچیزی که باید توش باشه و نیست رو پیاده سازی کنه از ui دیزارنر بپرس و باگ هاش رو هم بگیرخ و بهترش کنه اینم تسک کن و خودکار هنددلش کن
verbatim_quote.english_translation: By the way, hand the whole UI/UX to the system: implement everything that should be in it and is missing, ask the UI Designer, catch its bugs and improve it. Make this a task and handle it automatically.
